scenicChapters.title: Villages on Kuroshima Island → Kasuga Village and Sacred Places in Hir
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 32 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-takashima-coal-mine-takashima-coa.story: A 222 km round trip from Nagasaki - roughly 3 h 50 in the saddle. On the way it passes Shitsu Village in Sotome, Villages on Kuroshima Island, Kasuga Village and Sacred Places in Hirado and back through Villages on Kuroshima Island. The line favours views over speed.

legend-fluela-pass-road.slogan: Fluela Pass Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-fluela-pass-road.story: curated scenic road. high alpine, lakes, hairpins. A one-way ride of 20 km, Davos to Zernez - roughly 22 min in the saddle. The highest point is about 2,400 m. Fluela Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 9 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
